messages:
marta.prod: Announcing a small burst-preview for A800X Dedicated in asia-south-1 (Chennai). This is intended to give customers short-term burst capacity for peak inference windows. :rocket:

marta.prod: Why A800X burst? Lower per-token cost for steady throughput workloads and very competitive FP16 throughput for mid-length sequences. Useful for customers who need predictable short bursts rather than long reserved capacity.

rahul.eng: Tech notes: A800X hosts are configured as 2x A800X per server with our latency-optimized kernel set. Were enabling dynamic burst scheduling and a thin reservation layer to avoid noisy-neighbor issues. Expect ~1.4x throughput vs A800 baseline for 512-2048 token ranges based on internal runs.

rahul.eng: Caveat: burst scheduler will preempt CPU-limited background tasks; were throttling burst to 15 minutes per tenant per hour by default in preview.

jess.ops: Rollout plan: pool name a800x-ap-chennai-burst-preview, soft-preview live now with limited quota (50 burst-units). Preview is time-limited and no SLA. GA targeted in ~18 days after telemetry review. Preview billing tag: preview-a800x-burst.

jess.ops: Access: customers request via internal form: https://internal.redwood/burst-preview (internal). Please tag requests here so we can approve them quickly.

deploy-bot: [capacity-event] created pool a800x-ap-chennai-burst-preview (pool-id: pool-a800x-chn-01) by jess.ops at 2026-05-02T07:10:12Z

billing-bot: [billing-note] tag applied: preview-a800x-burst to pool pool-a800x-chn-01 by jess.ops at 2026-05-02T07:11:03Z

kevin.sales: Sales note: Ill notify AE teams. Main messaging: short-burst capacity for handling daily peak traffic, ideal for ingestion spikes and batch re-ranking windows. Limited seats so emphasize approval workflow.

rahul.eng: Ops checklist for SRE/Platform:
```
- Add a800x-ap-chennai-burst-preview to routing with fallback to a800-ap-south and l4-ap-south.
- Enforce per-tenant burst cap = 15 minutes per hour (preview default).
- Enable burst-prefetch for KV caches to reduce cold-start latencies.
- Emit burst telemetry (burst_start/end, tenant_id, peak_rps) to separate preview metric stream.
```

rahul.eng: redwoodctl example to request a burst reservation for QA:
```
redwoodctl bursts create --pool pool-a800x-chn-01 --tenant tenant-acme --minutes 15 --justification "peak inference test"
```

marta.prod: Action items: Rahul monitor burst metrics and regressions; Jess maintain preview whitelist and weekly snapshots; Kevin prepare AE doc; Billing hold GA pricing until post-preview. Post any customer approvals/denials in this thread.

jess.ops: Noted  Ill publish the initial whitelist and share weekly capacity snapshots in #eng-ops.

kevin.sales: Will reach out to a few enterprise customers that asked for short burst options.

rahul.eng: If anyone hits unexpected preemption or queueing, please include job-id and burst reservation id and tag @rahul.eng.
